title: Jesus... I Apologised To My Dad And He Left Me On Read
topic: apologised to his father by text and the message was left on read

bible.text: So he got up and went to his father. But while he was still in the distance, his father saw him and was filled with compassion. He ran to his son, embraced him, and kissed him.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I rewrote my apology to Dad eleven times. Two blue ticks. No reply. 😔

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: He read it. Then he went very quiet.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Does quiet mean he doesn't care?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Quiet is not rejection. Some fathers need time to find words.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I just wanted to hear it's okay before I sleep.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then hear it from Me tonight. I saw you coming.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Give him today. Then send one line: I meant it.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone waiting on a reply. What message are you still waiting on? 👇
